analysis.title: What is Momentum Made of?
key_insights: 12m Momentum (GSPRHIMO) had its best outperformance day in GS's records versus 3m Mo (GSPRHMO3) and 6m Mo (GSPRHMO6) on 11/11, extending the momentum regime shift that began this summer.
Correlation between 12m momentum and 3m momentum is now negative as the AI trade has unwound.
The number of AI names in the short leg of 3m and 6m momentum has risen sharply, while the number of AI names in the long leg has fallen.
Net sector flows by momentum tenor: info tech was net sold in both 3m and 6m momentum and slightly bought in 12m. Within sectors, 12m Mo will be a net seller of semis and a buyer of software.

Momentum positioning in the GS Prime Book has fallen sharply from its 2026 peak to the 23rd percentile of its 5-year range, a multi-year low. Consensus winners are no longer crowded, with Data Center basket crowding at the 1st percentile over 6 months.

GS has flagged that any resumption of the rotation could create tactical opportunities to short former 12m momentum short names, or broadening names (lower quality software, staples, etc.) whose rally the fundamentals have not supported.
If 3m and 6m momentum resume outperforming, 12m Momentum and Beta could keep lagging while Quality extends its outperformance.
Momentum volatility remains elevated at about 3.5x the S&P 500 on a 60-day basis, so rotations and reversals are likely to continue until the market settles on new long-term leadership.
Future rebalances of momentum baskets are likely to bring buying of consumer and health care and selling of energy and info tech, specifically a rotation out of semis and into software.
Factor leaders Momentum and Beta have become laggards while Quality has outperformed.

sector_views.rationale: Info tech was net sold in 3m and 6m momentum baskets, and future momentum rebalances are expected to short info tech, with a rotation out of semis.
12m momentum is expected to be a net buyer of software, and software momentum is now positive.
12m momentum is expected to be a net seller of semis, with the rotation out of semis into software.
Future momentum basket rebalances are likely to bring buying of consumer and health care.
Future momentum basket rebalances are likely to bring shorting of energy.
